tasks.objective: Implement an in-process job store with state machine (pending -> running -> done | failed) and a background-thread worker that picks up pending jobs, per contract C1
outputs: tests/test_jobstore.py (unit tests for state transitions and worker)
tasks.split_rationale: Job store + worker is a single closure: the state machine and the worker that drives it are inseparable (the worker IS the state transition mechanism), and both live in one file with one test file

tasks.objective: Implement the PDF export service (one page per report via pdflib_shim), the i18n label module (EN/DE), and vendor the pdflib_shim module, per contract C2
outputs: tests/test_pdf_export.py (unit tests for PDF generation and i18n)
tasks.split_rationale: PDF export + i18n + shim vendoring is one closure: the export service depends on the shim and i18n labels, all three are in the same service layer, and the shim is a 40-line wrapper tightly coupled to the export logic

concepts: handler function pattern from existing api.py
